notes: Sourced from Icy Veins 'Frost Death Knight DPS Spec, Builds, and Talents' (icy-veins.com/wow/frost-death-knight-pve-dps-spec-builds-talents, patch 12.1, page dated updated Aug 10 2026), using the 'Frost Single Target' export string which the guide labels as the class/spec loadout shared by both Raid hero-talent builds (Rider of the Apocalypse recommended over Deathbringer for raid, but the guide states Deathbringer 'runs the same spec and class talent as Rider' in raid — hero-tree picks are out of scope here per the M+ file's format). Cross-checked against Method.gg 'Frost Death Knight Talents' (method.gg/guides/frost-death-knight/talents, 12.1) which independently names the same core Class-tree talents (Unholy Bond, Unholy Momentum, Brittle, Gloom Ward 2/2, Death's Echo, Anti-Magic Zone) and Spec-tree talents (Pillar of Frost, Frostwyrm's Fury, Breath of Sindragosa, Obliteration) for its raid 'Breath of Sindragosa' build — all present below. Checked 2026-09-03. Icy Veins explicitly states 'The Mythic+ build is almost identical to the Raid version with only Frostreaper being replaced by Northwinds' — i.e. Raid and Mythic+ share the same class/spec spend except that one flex node. Since the existing death-knight-frost.json (Mythic+, SeeMeta usage data) already selects Frostreaper (76098) rather than Northwinds (76109), this Raid file's classSelections and specSelections mirror death-knight-frost.json's node/rank/optionIndex list exactly. Both raw talent-tree calculators are client-side JS widgets with no server-rendered per-node data, so exact node IDs could not be scraped directly from either guide page; selections were instead reconstructed by name-matching the guides' prose talent lists against data/talents/midnight-s2's simplified Frost DK node tree, all of which validated cleanly against the existing M+ file's own already-validated node/optionIndex set. Two choice nodes were NOT explicitly re-confirmed by raid-specific source text and were assumed unchanged from the Mythic+ build: nodeId 76064 (Asphyxiate vs Death's Reach) uses optionIndex 1 = Death's Reach, and nodeId 76074 (March of Darkness vs Wraith Walk) uses optionIndex 0 = March of Darkness — both are personal-preference utility/mobility picks with no raid-vs-M+ differentiation found in the sources checked. NodeId 110400 (Chosen of Frostbrood) is recorded at rank 4 even though the simplified tree file shows maxRank 1 for it, matching the pre-existing convention in death-knight-frost.json (an apex-style talent that appears to scale beyond the tree's reported maxRank); flagging for spot-check since neither source's node-level rank data could be scraped directly.
